title: Trade and Foreign Investment (Protecting the Public Interest) Bill 2014
short_title: Trade and Foreign Investment (Protecting the Public Interest) Bill 2014

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would prevent the Commonwealth from entering international agreements that include investor-state dispute settlement clauses, covering agreements with one or more foreign countries.
The restriction would target agreement clauses that allow corporations to sue foreign governments in specific circumstances through investor-state dispute settlement arrangements.
The prohibition would cover agreements involving one or more foreign countries and would begin on the day after the bill received Royal Assent.
changes: The Commonwealth would be barred from entering agreements containing investor-state dispute settlement clauses.
The restriction would extend to agreements involving multiple foreign countries.
The restriction would take effect the day after Royal Assent.
summary.affected: The Commonwealth and corporations covered by the specified dispute settlement clauses are affected.
